slides.texte_overlay:
keeping score of wins

write down one thing you handled well every night before bed. confidence isn't a feeling you wait for, it's a pile of proof you collect on purpose, day after day.

doing it scared

pick one thing a week that scares you a little and do it anyway: a call, a question, a solo trip. courage is just doing it while the fear is still there.

dressing one level up

dress one level better than you need to, every day for a month. people treat you differently, and more importantly, you start treating yourself differently.

knowing a little more

spend 5 minutes a day learning about something new: a famous painting, a moment in history, how the brain works. knowing things gives you a calm in conversations that nothing else can fake.
slides.texte_sophia:
knowing a little more

spend 5 minutes a day learning about something new: a famous painting, how the brain works. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and knowledge gives you a calm nothing can fake.

slides.texte_overlay:
keeping your word to you

make one small promise to yourself every morning and keep it, no matter what. the person you trust most should be you, and that trust is built one kept promise at a time.
